title: Identifying and Predicting Autism Spectrum Disorder Based on Multi-Site Structural MRI With Machine Learning
summary: Multisite structural MRI features and machine-learning models classified autism-spectrum disorder and identified predictive regional brain features, with cross-site evaluation.
